name: Dickinson's Real Deal
description: David Dickinson and the team travel the country hoping for some good deals. But will the locals take the cash for their antiques or gamble at auction?

videos.title: Bingham
videos.overview: David Dickinson and his dealers are in Bingham in Nottinghamshire, where Cheryl Hakeney has a nice little urn on her table that will be a nice little urner.

videos.title: Middlesborough 3
videos.overview: The Duke is in Middlesbrough, where Cheryl Hakeney tries to pick up a famous face and Fay Rutter and Stewart Hofgartner are offered treasures from the Potteries.

videos.title: Blackpool 4
videos.overview: David and the dealers are in Blackpool, where Henry Nicholls proposes a deal for some rings, and Matt Taylor is faced with a unique local historical gem.

videos.title: RAF London 3
videos.overview: David Dickinson hosts from the RAF Museum in north London as a host of bargains that include a bronze bust of George IV turn up in the Den.

videos.title: RAF London 4
videos.overview: David Dickinson presents from the RAF Museum in north London as one seller travels all the way from Brighton with his Moorcroft collection just to meet Alison Chapman.

videos.title: Bosworth 3
videos.overview: David Dickinson hosts from Bosworth Hall in Market Bosworth in Leicestershire as Real Deal regulars Angela and David mark their eighth appearance on the show.

videos.title: Bosworth 4
videos.overview: David Dickinson presents from Bosworth Hall in Market Bosworth in Leicestershire as a big painting, a big cash offer, and a big surprise no await Stewart Hofgartner.

videos.title: Walsall 2
videos.overview: David Dickinson hosts from Walsall Football Club in the West Midlands as a set of false teeth found in a loft cause a stir and James Layte explains what a dumpy level is.

videos.title: Walsall 4
videos.overview: David Dickinson hosts from Walsall Football Club in the West Midlands as a fascinating family collection of 400 First World War postcards turns up in the Dealers' Den.

videos.title: Newark 1
videos.overview: David Dickinson hosts from Newark Showground in Nottinghamshire as a mystery medallion has everyone guessing and a seller gets a huge surprise from Tracy Thackray-Howitt.

videos.title: Newark 2
videos.overview: David Dickinson presents from Newark Showground in Nottinghamshire as Simon Schneider literally throws his money around and Mark Stevens has to phone a friend.

videos.title: Newark 3
videos.overview: David Dickinson hosts from the Newark Showground as Henry Nicholls pays more than he intends for a portrait painting and Simon Schneider misses out on a ring.

videos.title: Newark 4
videos.overview: David Dickinson hosts from the Newark Showground as a prehistoric collection of fossils found locally is described as someone's favourite-ever items.

videos.title: Stoke 1
videos.overview: David Dickinson is in Stoke in Staffordshire as a ceramic cat aims to deliver a 'purrfect' profit and Mark Stevens finds the offer of an Italian meal too good to refuse.

videos.title: Fleetwood 1
videos.overview: David Dickinson is in Fleetwood in Lancashire as a book signed by LS Lowry is examined and Karen Dalmeny aims to turn a collection of gold into thousands of pounds.
